arguments.value: Shelby J. Butterfield and the Butterfield Family Trust, acting through Shelby J. Butterfield as co-trustee, agree to jointly prepare and file this Schedule 13G or Schedule 13D and any future amendments with the proper regulators to report their ownership of the issuer’s securities. Each party is responsible for the timely filing, completeness, and accuracy of its own information, but not for the other party’s information unless it knows or has reason to believe that information is inaccurate. The source states no term or duration.
